program: AWS Activate (Activate Credits: Founders and Portfolio tiers)
stopper_list: Government Entity exclusion: not eligible if majority-owned, controlled or substantially funded by government at any level, incl. government-owned corporations (https://aws.amazon.com/activate/terms/)
Pre-Series B, funding up to and including Series A; Series B+ or private equity rejected (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits ; https://startups.aws.com/faq)

Tier fit and accurate funding data: Founders is for self-funded startups; funding stage and most recent funding date are asked; inconsistent business information rejected (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits ; https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/ ; https://startups.aws.com/faq)

Portfolio needs an Org ID from an Activate Provider, and the provider must confirm the affiliation within 30 days (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits ; https://startups.aws.com/faq ; https://startups.aws.com/lp/activate-benefits-overview?lang=en-US)

Most recent funding round within 12 months of applying (https://startups.aws.com/lp/activate-benefits-overview?lang=en-US ; https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)
AWS account on Paid Tier plan, active and in good standing (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits ; https://startups.aws.com/faq)
New to Activate Credits or requesting more than previously received across all AWS accounts (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits ; https://startups.aws.com/faq)

Functioning website or public profile showing the company name, crawlable (robots.txt), not under construction (https://startups.aws.com/faq ; https://startups.aws.com/lp/activate-benefits-overview?lang=en-US)

Application email domain must match the AWS account email domain; free email providers not accepted (https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/ ; https://startups.aws.com/lp/activate-benefits-overview?lang=en-US)

AWS account linked to the applicant's Builder ID with root or admin permissions; one Builder ID per account (https://startups.aws.com/faq ; https://aws.amazon.com/startups/learn/applying-for-aws-activate-credits-a-step-by-step-guide/)
Possible identity verification via Trulioo link; declining means rejection (https://startups.aws.com/faq)
One application at a time (smaller one auto-rejected); no edits after submission, only cancel and resubmit (https://startups.aws.com/faq)
